title: Background end: a detached compound launcher line reports TerminalNotConfirmed instead of the compound refusal, and the compound refusal paths are not tested separately
outcome: A Claude compound launcher line records the compound refusal (ArtifactRequestMismatch, ObservationMatches=false) at its background end even when it is detached, and the shared-association refusal and the background-end refusal for compound lines are each pinned by their own behaviour test.
acceptance: attach_claude_background_launcher_artifact evaluates the compound (non-simple) guard before the detached check, so `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --input commit --detach --notify coordinator && echo done` records ArtifactRequestMismatch/ObservationMatches=false while a simple detached line keeps TerminalNotConfirmed; a foreground compound Claude launcher line records the refusal through observe_test_command_artifact_from alone; and a background-end test whose launch row carries no earlier refusal shows the background end records it; each shown by its own behaviour test.
